chunks: And if you obey most of those on the earth, they will lead you astray from the path of God. They follow only conjecture, and they do but guess.
ai.seo_question: Why does following the majority of people lead to misguidance according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between the 'majority' (akthar) and the 'believers' (mu'minun), noting that the masses often follow blind imitation (taqlid) rather than reasoned conviction. It serves as a critical reminder that numerical popularity does not equate to divine truth, as the majority typically relies on الظن (conjecture) rather than definitive knowledge (yaqin).
